title: Research Software Identity Audit
description: Operational, evidence, provenance, and reproducibility infrastructure for the OSF-preregistered longitudinal audit of research software identity propagation across open scholarly infrastructures. This repository supports the study and is not an eleventh research-software object in the fixed ten-object corpus.
notes: The OSF registration is the frozen research contract. GitHub and Zenodo provide the live implementation and archival/citation surfaces for this research infrastructure.
